name: A Dozen Bloomin' Roses: The Visual Novel Adaptation
source:
A strange new customer enters the flower shop, looking to buy some flowers.

Based on the short story of the same name from the 1987 short story collection Quirky Tails by Paul Jennings.

[From [url=https://filthysilver.itch.io/a-dozen-bloomin-roses]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位陌生的新顾客走进花店，想要买一些花。

改编自保罗·詹宁斯1987年短篇小说集Quirky Tails中的同名短篇小说。

[来自[url=https://filthysilver.itch.io/a-dozen-bloomin-roses]Itch.io[/url]]
